title: Capability ontology and benchmark seeds
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for polyhierarchical capability and niche ontology graphs, typed AI tool, MCP server, feed and OSS release intelligence cards, durable queue and hackathon radar matrices, multi-axis Pareto benchmarks, root ecosystem seed catalogs and bounded multi-generation seed digestion.
boundaries: Workers remain stateless claimants of Tessera verbs and never create a rival task, scheduler, custom seed-pack primitive or policy authority.
Seed digestion advances one bounded hop (generation_depth + 1) preserving parent_task_id and source_task_id while keeping follow-up work inert inside proposed_verbs and proposed_nouns.
Polyhierarchical capability graphs use cycle-checked parent_ids DAGs and open-ended facet labels rather than single-parent trees or fixed-depth locks.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for polyhierarchical capability ontologies, typed tool and MCP intelligence cards, bounded multi-generation seed digestion and Pareto benchmark ranking

value.lets_workers: Maintain cycle-free polyhierarchical capability DAGs where tools belong simultaneously to multiple functional niches and runtime footprints (for example ocr_document_intelligence, pii_redaction_and_privacy and runs_on_small_4gb_laptop), normalize AI tools, MCP servers, feeds, durable queues, architecture patterns and OSS releases with canonical I/O-port signature hashes, digest root seeds one bounded hop at a time (generation_depth + 1) into /q/submit-compatible task_objects and queued_verbs, rank candidates on a 7-axis Pareto frontier under NodeGrid regimes and synthesize deterministic 4-beat component demos.

flow.when: Digest a root or intermediate capability seed by one bounded hop (generation_depth + 1), deduplicating near-duplicate branches via shingle Jaccard and preserving parent_task_id and source_task_id.
Validate AI tool, MCP server, feed and queue intelligence cards, compute canonical I/O-port SHA-256 signatures and group interchangeable candidates.
Harvest new open-source releases, papers and hackathon patterns and diff I/O signatures, licenses, RAM footprints and MCP tool lists against prior cards.
Execute head-to-head micro-benchmark scoring across cost, sub-10ms p99 latency, 4GB laptop fit, zero-dep maintainability, Kubernetes readiness, accuracy and demo reproducibility.
Synthesize a deterministic 4-beat runnable component demo and failure-mode walkthrough for top-ranked niche tools.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 16-node polyhierarchical ecosystem bundle recomputed in test_capability_ontology_seeds.py: validates 3 multi-parent intersection nodes across 10 AI niches plus 3 operational facets, projects edge_ocr_pii_redactor across OCR + PII + 4GB laptop parents, clusters hot-swappable OCR+PII cards by canonical I/O port SHA-256, diffs a new MCP release tool, digests gen 0 -> gen 1 -> gen 2 while suppressing a near-duplicate branch, computes a 2-candidate Pareto frontier under edge_small_footprint and passes AST and domain-agnostic naming gates.

nouns.category_reason: Preserves Tessera as sole task and storage authority while reusing NodeGrid, GridLedger, CapabilityNode, ToolProfile, VerbEnvelope and EvaluationRecord.
